G = nx.Graph()
G.add_edges_from(edges)
count = nx.number_connected_components(G)
is_connected = (count == 1)
display = f"The graph has {count} connected components"

return {"count": count, "display": display, "is_connected": is_connected}

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_edges_from(edges)
tri_dict = nx.triangles(G)
total_triangles = sum(tri_dict.values()) // 3
display = f"The graph contains {total_triangles} unique triangle"
if total_triangles != 1:
    display = f"The graph contains {total_triangles} unique triangles"

return {"total_triangles": total_triangles, "display": display}
